title: SEC2: transit JoinHandle drain is efficient
description: Transit ingestion drain in crates/transit/src/main.rs lines 921-938 is efficient and idiomatic. Pattern: drop ingestion_sender to close channel, then tokio::time::timeout(drain_secs, ingestion_handle).await. Dropping the last sender causes ingestion_receiver.recv() to return None, terminating the while-let loop in the task. Awaiting a JoinHandle is a zero-overhead wakeup. No polling, no spin. This is the canonical Tokio pattern for draining a background task before shutdown. No efficiency concern.
notes: opinion: This is a confirmatory 'no issue' note, not a finding. It verifies transit JoinHandle drain is idiomatic and efficient. No actionable work items. No engineering basis for keeping this as an open issue requiring action.
